mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active whenever FEDFUNDS is below historical averages.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (historical median), or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195.0) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 195.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and robust housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained consumer demand, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with strong GDPC1 and HOUST, or the Rank IC for the demand signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer and housing demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), low unemployment signals strong consumer spending power, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
